proposed_widenings.name: DiceDelta.slot_threshold_tiers
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic Weapon's upcast produces +1 (slot 2), +2 (slots 3–5), +3 (slot 6+). The modify_roll_numeric and modify_damage_numeric atoms carry a DiceDelta for their delta — but DiceDelta has no slot-level scaling mechanism. The only structured alternatives (fixed_dice, proficiency_bonus, ability_modifier, magic_item_rarity_bonus) are all static. Expressing slot-scaled flat bonuses requires a new DiceDelta variant analogous to DiceAmount.threshold_tiers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3-5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

notes: Base encoding (slot 2, +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls) is fully representable and typecheck/tracer pass cleanly. The ongoing_effect family with object attachment, passive trigger operations, modify_roll_numeric + modify_damage_numeric, timed 1-hour duration with caster_recasts_spell early end — all fit without modification to types.ts. The only gap is the upcast scaling: the delta field on both operations is a DiceDelta which cannot express slot-level threshold steps. The authored file encodes slot-2 only (+1) and notes the omission. A DiceDelta.slot_threshold_tiers variant (atSlot + value pairs, like DurationUpcastTier) would close this gap across all slot-scaled numeric-bonus spells.
